title: 包装材料与废弃物
summary: 评估公司包装减量化、可回收材料使用及包装废弃物管理绩效。

sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Packaging Material & Waste Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Packaging Material & Waste is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their production of or reliance upon packaging materials, their potential exposure to waste management and packaging regulations, as well as their efforts to reduce the environmental impact of packaging materials.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍包装材料与废弃物关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）¹ 如何形成评估结果。包装材料与废弃物属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型环境支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖其包装材料生产或依赖程度、废弃物管理和包装法规带来的潜在风险敞口，以及减少包装材料环境影响的措施。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Loss of access to markets due to reform of regulations governing packaging material and waste.
blocks.content_cn: • 因包装材料与废弃物监管法规改革而丧失市场准入。

blocks.content: • Loss of revenue due to changing consumer preferences.
blocks.content_cn: • 因消费者偏好变化而损失收入。

blocks.content: • Increased costs to reformulate packaging and comply with producer responsibility regulations.
blocks.content_cn: • 因重新设计包装及遵守生产者责任法规而增加成本。

The Key Issue score on this Key Issue is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue score.

sections.title_cn: 包装材料与废弃物实践得分

blocks.content: The Packaging Material & Waste Practices score evaluates the company’s ability to manage its exposure to risks related to its production of or reliance upon packaging materials, as well as its efforts to reduce the environmental impact of packaging materials. This score is a component of the Packaging Material & Waste Management score (excluding controversies) and considers attributes of the company's policies and initiatives. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 包装材料与废弃物实践得分评估公司管理包装材料生产或依赖相关风险敞口的能力，以及减少包装材料环境影响的措施。该得分是包装材料与废弃物管理得分（不含争议调整）的组成部分，考察公司政策与举措的特征。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_cn: • 包装材料构成披露

blocks.content: Definition: How transparent the company is about the type of materials used in its packaging. Best practice is full disclosure.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司对其包装所用材料类型的透明程度。最佳实践是充分披露。

sections.title_en: • Scope of consumer programs to reduce waste
sections.title_cn: • 面向消费者的减废计划覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the company’s consumer education programs on recycling (e.g., take-back locations) or recycling instructions.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司面向消费者开展回收教育计划（例如介绍回收点）或提供回收指引的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: • Scope of recycling programs where not mandated by law
blocks.content_cn: • 无法律强制要求情况下回收计划的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company’s involvement in recycling or recovery of packaging materials in locations or circumstances where packaging waste recycling is not mandated by law. Best practice is to have an overarching packaging waste strategy.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：在法律未强制要求回收包装废弃物的地点或情形下，公司参与包装材料再循环或回收的程度。最佳实践是制定全面的包装废弃物战略。

sections.title_en: • Strategy to reduce the environmental impact of packaging
sections.title_cn: • 减少包装环境影响的战略

blocks.content: Definition: The comprehensiveness of the company’s strategy to reduce the environmental impact of its packaging, such as through waste elimination, packaging redesign, and engagement with suppliers or customers. Best practice is to have specific initiatives that reduce the environmental impact of packaging.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司减少包装环境影响战略的全面程度，例如通过消除废弃物、重新设计包装，以及与供应商或客户合作。最佳实践是采取能够减少包装环境影响的具体举措。

sections.title_cn: • 包装成分相关目标

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's targets and their scope focused on recycled material content of packaging. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司围绕包装再生材料含量设定的目标及其覆盖范围。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: ◦ Scope of targets to increase recycled material content of packaging
sections.title_cn: ◦ 提高包装再生材料含量目标的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the scope of a company's target to incorporate postconsumer recycled materials into its packaging.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司将消费后再生材料用于包装的目标覆盖范围。

sections.title_en: ◦ Targets to increase recycled or renewable material content of packaging
sections.title_cn: ◦ 提高包装再生或可再生材料含量的目标

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has specific targets for improving packaging content, such as increasing recycled content, renewable content, or eliminating problematic or hard-to-recycle plastic content.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否设定改善包装成分的具体目标，例如提高再生材料或可再生材料含量，或消除存在问题及难以回收的塑料成分。

sections.title_en: • Targets related to packaging material circularity or waste elimination
sections.title_cn: • 包装材料循环利用或废弃物消除相关目标

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's targets and their scope focused on packaging material circularity or waste elimination. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司围绕包装材料循环利用或废弃物消除设定的目标及其覆盖范围。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: ◦ Scope of targets for packaging material circularity or waste elimination
sections.title_cn: ◦ 包装材料循环利用或废弃物消除目标的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates the scope of environmental targets related to material recovery or waste elimination in packaging.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明包装中材料回收或废弃物消除相关环境目标的覆盖范围。

sections.title_en: ◦ Targets for packaging material circularity or waste elimination
sections.title_cn: ◦ 包装材料循环利用或废弃物消除目标

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has specific targets related to improving product recovery through packaging.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否设定通过包装改善产品回收的具体目标。

sections.title_cn: 包装材料与废弃物绩效得分

blocks.content: The Packaging Material & Waste Performance score evaluates the company's performance on packaging material & waste metrics (including achievements on packaging content and product recovery). It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 包装材料与废弃物绩效得分评估公司相关指标的表现，包括包装成分和产品回收方面取得的成果。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: • Scope of environmental improvements in packaging
sections.title_cn: • 包装环境改善的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's achievements on packaging content (e.g. light-weighted, recycled content).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在包装成分方面取得的成果，例如轻量化和再生材料含量。

sections.title_en: • Scope of product or packaging recovery
sections.title_cn: • 产品或包装回收的覆盖范围

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company's achievements on product or packaging recovery.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司在产品或包装回收方面取得的成果。

sections.title_cn: 争议事件

sections.title_cn: 包装材料与废弃物风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Packaging Material & Waste Exposure score evaluates the company’s exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure scores. The Geographic Exposure score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to the Analyzing risk exposure section of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 包装材料与废弃物风险敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的风险敞口，以业务和地域风险敞口得分为基础。地域风险敞口得分作为业务风险敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务与地域风险敞口得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高风险，0 分对应最低风险。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》的“风险敞口分析”章节。风险敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ { P M W , i } = B U S _ { P M W , i } ( 1 + 0 . 1 \big ( G E O _ { P M W , i } - 5 \big ) )
$$
Where:

blocks.content: $E X P _ { P M W , i }$ is the Packaging Material & Waste Exposure score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: $E X P _ { P M W , i }$ 为公司 i 的包装材料与废弃物风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: $B U S _ { P M W , i }$ is the Business Exposure score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: $B U S _ { P M W , i }$ 为公司 i 的业务风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: $G E O _ { P M W , i }$ is the Geographic Exposure score of company i.
blocks.content_cn: $G E O _ { P M W , i }$ 为公司 i 的地域风险敞口得分。

sections.title_cn: 业务板块敞口得分

blocks.content: The Packaging Material and Waste Business Segment Exposure score is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score.
blocks.content_cn: 包装材料与废弃物业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: Each business activity score is determined by a simple average of the Plastic Packaging Use and Waste Intensity score and the Plastic Packaging Reliance score.
blocks.content_cn: 各业务活动得分由塑料包装使用与废弃物强度得分及塑料包装依赖度得分的简单平均值确定。

blocks.content_cn: 业务活动 j 的塑料包装依赖度得分。

blocks.content: The Plastic Packaging Use and Waste Intensity score for each business activity is determined by a combined measure of plastic use and plastic waste intensities in metric tons per million euros of economic output in the business activity.
blocks.content_cn: 各业务活动的塑料包装使用与废弃物强度得分，由塑料使用强度和塑料废弃物强度的综合指标确定，单位为该业务活动每百万欧元经济产出的公吨数。

blocks.content: The Plastic Packaging Reliance score for each business activity is determined by a qualitative assessment of whether packaging plays a critical role in the delivery of products and services and whether plastic is a common form of packaging material used.
blocks.content_cn: 各业务活动的塑料包装依赖度得分通过定性评估确定，考察包装是否对产品及服务交付至关重要，以及塑料是否为常用包装材料。

sections.title_cn: 地理分区敞口得分

blocks.content: The Geographic Segment Exposure score is determined by a simple average of the Recycling Mandates score, the Extended Producer Responsibility score, the Single-use Plastic Law score and the Plastic Waste Mismanagement score:
blocks.content_cn: 地域分部风险敞口得分由强制回收要求得分、生产者责任延伸得分、一次性塑料法规得分和塑料废弃物管理不善得分的简单平均值确定：

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: $R M _ { c }$ is the Recycling Mandates score in country or market c.
blocks.content_cn: $R M _ { c }$ 为国家或市场 c 的强制回收要求得分。

blocks.content: $E P R _ { c }$ is the Extended Producer Responsibility score in country or market .
blocks.content_cn: $E P R _ { c }$ 为相应国家或市场的生产者责任延伸得分。（原文此处国家或市场标识缺失，待校核。）

blocks.content: $S U P _ { c }$ is the Single-use plastics score in country or market .
blocks.content_cn: $S U P _ { c }$ 为相应国家或市场的一次性塑料得分。（原文此处国家或市场标识缺失，待校核。）

blocks.content: $P W M _ { c }$ is the Plastic Waste Mismanagement score in country or market .
blocks.content_cn: $P W M _ { c }$ 为相应国家或市场的塑料废弃物管理不善得分。（原文此处国家或市场标识缺失，待校核。）

blocks.content: The Recycling Mandates score is based on a country’s recycling mandate policies’ stringency and the extent to which the policies are applied within a country or market.
blocks.content_cn: 强制回收要求得分以国家强制回收政策的严格程度，以及政策在该国家或市场内的适用范围为基础。

blocks.content: The Extended Producer Responsibility score is based on a country’s extended producer responsibility regulations’ stringency and the extent to which the policies are applied within a country or market.
blocks.content_cn: 生产者责任延伸得分以国家生产者责任延伸法规的严格程度，以及政策在该国家或市场内的适用范围为基础。

blocks.content: The Single-use Plastic Law score is based on a country’s single-use plastics regulations’ stringency and the extent to which the policies are applied within a country or market.
blocks.content_cn: 一次性塑料法规得分以国家一次性塑料法规的严格程度，以及政策在该国家或市场内的适用范围为基础。

blocks.content: The Plastic Waste Mismanagement score for each country is based on the quantity of plastic waste generated per capita.
blocks.content_cn: 各国的塑料废弃物管理不善得分以人均塑料废弃物产生量为基础。

sections.title_cn: 数据来源

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Packaging Material & Waste Exposure score:
blocks.content_cn: 确定包装材料与废弃物风险敞口得分时使用以下来源：

blocks.content: “Plastics Policy Inventory,” Duke University; United Nations Environment Programme, Legal Limits on Single-Use Plastics and Microplastics: A Global Review of National Laws and Regulations; “What A Waste Global Database,” World Bank; Cimpan, C., Bjelle, E.L., and Strømman, A.H., “Plastic packaging flows in Europe: A hybrid input-output approach,” Journal of Industrial Ecology 25, no. 6: 1572-1587; World Development Indicators, World Bank; Refinitiv; MSCI S&C; and company disclosures.
blocks.content_cn: 杜克大学《塑料政策清单》；联合国环境规划署《一次性塑料与微塑料的法律限制：各国法律法规全球审查》；世界银行“全球固体废弃物数据库”；Cimpan, C.、Bjelle, E.L. 与 Strømman, A.H.，《欧洲塑料包装流：混合投入产出方法》，《产业生态学杂志》第 25 卷第 6 期：1572—1587 页；世界银行《世界发展指标》；路孚特；MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队；公司披露。
